title: Guide to navigating the Mobile App
help: The app is made up of several cross-cutting modules that the user can choose from freely: listen to the message, read the verse of the day, do the devotional and, to go deeper, answer the questions. These questions are aimed at children who are most interested in learning about the word of God. Additionally, there is a model prayer based on the devotional that helps children learn to pray in different ways. Finally, for the most adventurous, there is the challenge section, which asks you to make a much harder effort.
